column1: # Fate/Samurai Remnant (Omega Force / Koei Tecmo; update 1.3.2): experimental bring-up on Android, 2026-11-26.
# Tested: update 1.3.2 on an AYN Odin 2 (Adreno 740, KIMCHI turnip v26.0.0_R8).
# Plays the opening, the first fights, the boss fight and the town. The first fight's 3D scene was black until game.tsv's android_fetch1d buffer row.

# DM_VK_X_FENCES=1: with Turnip every submission that signals the timeline semaphore blocked in vkQueueSubmit (boss fight: queue submit
# 15.2 ms a frame, whole frame 37-38 ms against 31 ms of GPU work). Same fix as 01003AF0200B0000 and 010055D009F78000 (settings.tsv DM_VK_X_FENCES)
env
# The game's own dynamic resolution never lowered its ratio (KTGL +0x1800 stayed 1.0; boss fight 27-28 fps, GPU 25-30 ms a frame). patches.py multiplies the ratio by
# the host render scale; DM_DYN_SCALE steers it from the GPU p90 (budget 85% of 33.3 ms). Measured by hand with a fixed scale, same spot handheld:
# 1.0 = GPU 25-30 ms, frame work 33.4 ms; 0.6 = GPU 19-24 ms, frame work 25.5 ms. Power changed about 2% (5.8 W vs 5.7 W): the gain is frame headroom, not battery.
# A later battle needed GPU 33-35 ms a frame at 0.70 (25-29 fps; clock at its 680 MHz top, 61 C). A 0.50 floor gave back only 3-7 ms (GPU busy ~32 ms, 24-26 fps)
# and looked blurry: DM_VK_PASS_TIMES showed 300-418 passes a frame, ~8 ms of them shadow maps (1024x2048, 1024x1024) that do not follow the scale. Floor back to 0.70
env
# The game paces itself at 30 fps with present interval 1, so the budget read 60 fps (14.2 ms) and held the scale at its floor; DM_DYN_FPS=30 makes it 28.3 ms
env
# Battle freezes of 0.4-2 s the first time a scene shows: its draws into fresh targets (400x225, 1920x1080) kept their new pipelines on the replay thread, 22 builds in
# 1946 ms in one present (Turnip: 45-415 ms a build). The seed (vk_pipelines_seed.bin) cannot cover them: the skinning shaders' integer-texture bindings 3-8 make a
# new variant for each mix of characters. DM_VK_SYNC_PIPE_MS=100 caps that present's builds at about 100 ms, the rest go to the background threads
env
# Then battle freezes of 190-600 ms from compute pipelines (DM_VK_PROF_SLOW: `compute pipelines 590.1 ms`, no graphics pipeline built): the bundle has 497 compute
# shaders, over the default cap of 256, so none were made ahead. Raised so every one is built on a background thread at the first submission
env
